evidence: Carries the Tests label and updates functional test framework core files (test/functional/test_framework/test_node.py and util.py).
rationale: Fixes fatal test framework failures in `interface_ipc*.py` on NetBSD caused by exceeding the platform's FD limit. Commit 62571e7e67 explains that `-ipcbind`'s reserved descriptors pushed node startup requirements over 256, triggering a connection warning treated as a test failure.
